title: Predictive coding in the visual cortex: a functional interpretation of some extra-classical receptive-field effects
relevance: Foundational neuroscience paper on predictive coding. Establishes the framework of hierarchical prediction with error propagation that inspires speculative decode approaches.

title: Faster zlib/DEFLATE decompression on the Apple M1 (and x86)
relevance: Implements a 2-literal fast path that is a practical form of predictive decode. Shows ~4% speedup from assuming consecutive literals.

title: Analysis of branch prediction via data compression
relevance: Formal analysis connecting data compression to branch prediction. Shows that compression models and prediction models share mathematical foundations.
